name: localsend
description: An open-source cross-platform alternative to AirDrop
one_liner: A free app that lets you send files between your phone, laptop, and other devices over your own WiFi — like AirDrop, but it works between any brand of phone or computer.
buyer: An IT admin at a school or clinic who needs to move files between devices without using cloud storage or paid transfer apps.
business_use_cases: A school IT department deploys it across mixed Android/iPhone/Windows devices so students and staff can share files without a cloud account.
A hardware maker (NAS or router vendor) embeds it into their device's firmware as a built-in file-sharing feature.
An MSP bundles it into a 'secure offline file transfer' package for clients in regulated industries who can't use cloud sync.

money_ideas.idea: License the underlying tech to hardware makers who want built-in cross-platform sharing.
Offer paid enterprise deployment and support contracts for regulated organizations that need offline file transfer.

steal_this: Not much to 'steal' here since the app itself is already free and mature with 90k+ stars — the opportunity is a support/deployment service around it, not the app itself.
